title: bug: claim_next_task and release_task run their disk-state git status (up to 3 s) under the global state mutex: neither is marked blocking, so McpAdapter wraps the whole handler and every tool fleet-wide stalls behind the subprocess that diskState.ts says must run outside the lock
description:
Found by defect hunt #13 (task-cc441586). Line numbers are at HEAD f159784e.

PROBLEM
- util/diskState.ts:19-22 states the rule (invariant 2): "Callers MUST invoke this OUTSIDE the state mutex. It spawns a git subprocess that can take up to the 3s timeout; ... running it under the lock would freeze every tool fleet-wide".
- Both callers were written to follow it:
  - tools/releaseTask.ts:178-191 captures the handoff fingerprint in a "pre-mutex region ... never inside runExclusive" (computeDiskStateSignature at :186). Its own state.runExclusive starts at :194.
  - tools/claimNextTask.ts:422-424 says the recompute "must never run under the global state mutex". Its runExclusive is at :429, and the post-mutex recompute is at :1008-1019 ("The mutex is released — safe to shell out to git").
- Neither tool sets `blocking: true`. So server/McpAdapter.ts:309 (`tool.blocking ? await invoke() : await this.state.runExclusive(invoke)`) wraps the WHOLE handler. The mutex is reentrant, so it stays held through the git call.
- `blocking` is read only at McpAdapter.ts:309. The dispatch comment at :301-303 still calls claim_next_task "safe to wrap".
- The transports disagree: /ws RELEASE_TASK (server/WebSocketServer.ts:723-740) calls the same handler with no wrapper, so the capture runs unlocked there as intended.
- Precedent: submit_plan opts out the same way for its bounded cached-Git lookup (tools/submitPlan.ts:198 `blocking: true`; packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md:5).

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-cc441586/B/diskStateUnderMutex.test.ts. Copy it into packages/moe-daemon/src/__hunt__/ of a `git archive f159784e` snapshot.
- It mocks computeDiskStateSignature with a 600 ms git stand-in, records state.mutex.isHeld() during it, and times a bystander moe.list_tasks.
- Command: `npx vitest run src/__hunt__/diskStateUnderMutex.test.ts`. Result: 2 failed. Verbatim:
```
release_task: mutex held during git = [ true ] ; bystander list_tasks waited 567 ms
claim_next_task: mutex held during git = [ true ] ; bystander list_tasks waited 571 ms
× release_task with a handoffNote: git runs outside the mutex and does not stall other tools
× claim_next_task of a task whose newest handoff carries a diskState: git runs outside the mutex
AssertionError: expected [ true ] to deeply equal [ false ]
```
- Exposure:
  - Every MCP release_task that carries a handoffNote stalls all tool dispatch and /ws mutations for as long as git runs, up to the 3 s kill.
  - The board holds 18 handoff notes and none carries a diskState, so every capture so far failed or timed out.
  - `git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v2 --branch` took 4.35 s from WSL over /mnt/d. The live daemon runs on Windows, so that timing is indicative only.
  - The claim-side stall stays dormant until a stored diskState exists.

FIX DIRECTION
- Mark moe.claim_next_task and moe.release_task `blocking: true`, the submit_plan precedent. Both already do every state read-modify-write inside their own state.runExclusive:
  - claim_next_task's handler (:421) has no await before :429 and writes nothing after it;
  - release_task does only validation and the capture before :194.
- Update the McpAdapter dispatch comment (:301-303) and the blocking-tools list in packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md:5.
- Never move the capture into the mutex.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md is held at filing time: sync it only if lanes show it free at planning time.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/{claimNextTask,releaseTask}.ts, src/server/McpAdapter.ts (dispatch comment hunk only, ~:301-303; sibling hunt row on the rate limiter owns the env/RateLimiter hunks at ~:15-56), packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md, plus a new vitest file.
definitionOfDone: Through MCP dispatch, release_task's handoff disk-state capture and claim_next_task's post-claim recompute run with state.mutex.isHeld() false, and a bystander moe.list_tasks sent during a slow (mocked) capture returns before the capture ends, in a new vitest file.

Every claim and release mutation still runs inside the tool's own state.runExclusive (the existing claimNextTask and releaseTask tests pass unchanged), and the McpAdapter dispatch comment and packages/moe-daemon/CLAUDE.md's blocking-tools list name both tools.
`npx vitest run` of the new file plus src/tools/claimNextTask.test.ts and src/tools/releaseTask.test.ts passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
